items.title: A morphism from an algebraic space to a formal algebraic space is representable by algebraic spaces

items.difficulty_reason: The statement is that any morphism from an algebraic space over S to a formal algebraic space over S is representable by algebraic spaces (statement lines 2726-2731). The proof is short but completely displayed: a scheme-valued test object Z -> Y is fixed, representability is unwound to the single requirement that X x_Y Z be an algebraic space (proof lines 2733-2735), a scheme U with a surjective etale map U -> X is chosen (proof lines 2736-2736), and then two inputs are combined -- the base change U x_Y Z -> X x_Y Z of that covering is again representable surjective etale (proof lines 2737-2739), and U x_Y Z is a scheme by the diagonal lemma of the chapter (proof lines 2740-2741) -- after which the final bootstrap theorem upgrades the etale covering by an algebraic space to the conclusion that X x_Y Z is an algebraic space (proof lines 2742-2743). Every step of the reduction is present and the conclusion is reached; the level is H2 because the work consists in setting up the correct reduction and applying two external results, not in producing a new construction.
